title: AMBULANCE TRANSPORT (VARIANT 2)
note: Orphan continuation page in the source scan: SKILLS and ATTITUDE only. Wording differs slightly from the AMBULANCE TRANSPORT form on p1-2 (adds 'and/ or Midwifery Kit'). Its KNOWLEDGE page is not present in the supplied PDF; KNOWLEDGE below is carried over from the p1-2 form and should be confirmed by the hospital.
skills: Demonstrate checking the ambulance and the equipment required to meet specific individual patient needs e.g. Emergency Transport Bag and/ or Midwifery Kit.
Demonstrate loading and unloading ambulance stretcher or isolate depending on area of practice.
Demonstrate use of ambulance equipment and any standby switches for alternative power sources.
Demonstrate use of ambulance communication equipment as appropriate.
Demonstrate how to check oxygen cylinders including the spare ones
Demonstrate reporting process for diverting or stopping an ambulance during a trip.
Complete the documentation needed for an ambulance transport for area of practice.
attitude: To be calm and able to think critically and creatively with limited sources as required to care for the patient during the ambulance transport.
To be self-aware of limitation in knowledge and skills.
Ability of nurse to respond professionally and calmly if patient should deteriorate during the transfer.
Ability to communicate with EMS/ ER physician and Shift Supervisor/ Designee and respond to instruction as relevant and appropriate.
Demonstrate ability to organize and facilitate a reflection session in and on practice should an unexpected situation occur during an ambulance transfer future practice and response.
To be approachable and open to answer patient and family's questions.
